posts.text:
iran’s nuclear & ballistic missile programs were a real threat. more to israel and the gulf states than than to the united states, but real nonetheless. 

responding to that threat with an all out regime change war is one of the most irresponsible foreign policy decisions the united states has made in my lifetime. 

we will suffer the consequences of this mistake for years for years to come.

orban’s hungary by the numbers

2025 gdp growth: 0.4%
investment down 20% over last two years 
core inflation over 5%
hungarian bond yields: second highest in the eu

president trump prepared to strengthen the deeply underperforming hungary economy under prime minister viktor orban’s continued leadership. 

unclear whether this offer applies under future prime minster peter magyar, who is about to win sunday’s election.

trump doesn’t have a plan to reopen the strait. 

as long as that remains the case, extended negotiations without a breakthrough serve both the united states and the islamic republic.
yesterday was the first day of the war without any iranian attacks against israel and the uae.
this map is the story of the last 25 years of us foreign policy in its own backyard. and that was before the tariffs.
only 12% of europeans polled across six countries see the united states as a close ally. 36% see it as a threat.

though it's a near-term drag on their economy, china is one of the few winners from the iran war so far. oil stockpiles limit near-term energy risk. elevated oil prices boost demand for chinese clean-tech exports. us cruise missile stockpiles are depleted — and replenishment depends on chinese critical minerals. tomorrowsaffairs.com/even-ch…

only seven vessels have passed through the strait since the ceasefire went into effect on tuesday. 

six of them bulk cargo carriers, the other apparently a chinese-owned tanker.

57% of republicans under 50 now have an unfavorable view of israel.
the generational split inside the gop on israel is now as significant as the partisan split between parties.

the united states has the world's strongest military...and a glass jaw.

you don’t want american adversaries — or allies for that matter — feeling that way about the usa.

Video
trump now thinking greenland would have been easier than iran.
moose says he’d let tankers through if he were in charge of the strait.
“the pope? how many divisions has he?” - joseph stalin

hard to see the iran-israel component of a ceasefire holding. 

whether that breaks the broader us-iran agreement is an open question.
if kyiv believes it has a meaningful security guarantee from the united states at the moment it’s not listening carefully enough…
